Initial release of Living Architecture Decision Records (ADR) skill:

- Automatically drafts, numbers, and updates ADRs from git diffs, PR descriptions, or plain-English decisions.
- Detects architectural changes (database, auth, integrations, frameworks) from code changes.
- Marks older ADRs as "Superseded" when replaced by new decisions.
- Outputs formatted ADR files in docs/adr/ with sequential numbering.
- Operates entirely from your codebase and git history; no external APIs required.
- Triggered by plain English phrases or command-like inputs (e.g., /living-adr).
